Consumed by BOTH sides: server.py derives its prompt dicts from this file,

materials.texture_en: Soft, smooth knit with a subtle fine interlocking loop structure; medium weight, drapes softly and follows the furniture contours closely; matte finish, slightly stretchy appearance.

Authentic heavy upholstery bouclé made from clearly visible looped yarns. The surface is built from irregular open and closed yarn loops in mixed small-to-medium sizes, with uneven clusters, occasional larger curls, and tiny darker cavities between the loops. The loop scale remains readable at normal furniture-photography distance instead of collapsing into uniform grain. Soft wool-and-cotton character, dense and substantial, tactile three-dimensional relief, diffuse matte highlights, and subtle warm tonal variation between individual yarns. The distribution is organic and non-repeating, never a perfectly even pebble texture.

materials.note: NOT 'basketweave woven fabric' — the texture spec describes a fine, irregular, non-repeating weave, and the literal noun pulled the model toward a coarse regular basketweave that contradicted it (2026-08).
materials.texture_en: Medium-to-heavy upholstery fabric with a fine, irregular woven texture. Densely woven from slightly varied yarns, creating a subtle nubby, grainy surface with small broken horizontal and vertical threads. Soft tonal variation and a lightly mélange appearance give the fabric natural depth. Matte finish, substantial and durable, with a structured upholstery drape. The weave is small-scale, intricate and organic rather than a regular basketweave, with no large repeating pattern.

materials.note: 'woven' carries weight here — the bare noun let the model drift to velvet, which the texture spec explicitly rules out (2026-08). Picker CSS shows no glossy sheen sweep for the same reason.
materials.texture_en: Textured chenille upholstery fabric with a dense, irregular woven surface made from soft fuzzy chenille yarns. Medium-scale tactile texture with short uneven yarn segments, tiny soft ridges and subtle nubby loops creating a broken, organic crosshatched pattern. Plush and soft to the touch, with the woven yarn structure clearly visible across the whole surface. Rich dimensional surface with gentle tonal variation and soft shadowing between the yarns. Mostly matte with only a very subtle soft luster. Heavy, substantial upholstery fabric with a cozy, tactile appearance. Light scatters evenly across the surface in every direction, holding the same tone whichever way the fabric is brushed. Every part of the panel reads as discrete woven yarn segments with visible gaps between them. Highlights stay broad, diffuse and matte. The weave remains visibly irregular and broken across the entire panel.

materials.noun_en: fine irregular short-pile chenille upholstery fabric
materials.note: Profile derived primarily from four photographs of the physical Cremona sample (2026-09): frontal macro construction, opposing oblique angles and deformation over a fold. The furniture photograph is only a secondary scale check and must never override the real samples. At furniture distance the fabric is calm and finely tactile; directional nap shimmer is local and light-dependent, not a broad printed or marbled pattern.
materials.texture_en: Cremona is a fine, irregular short-pile chenille upholstery fabric. Its primary physical read is a dense, small-scale woven ground made from uneven short raised chenille nubs and slender slubs, arranged organically rather than as a regular grid. Each raised element is only a few millimetres across and many dozens span a cushion. At normal furniture-photography distance the surface reads calm, continuous and finely tactile; it must not become plain linen, but the weave must also never enlarge into chunky basketweave. Preserve crisp high-frequency separation between raised yarn and recessed ground: nub edges are fibrous, slightly frayed and irregular, never smoothly rounded, melted together or sponge-like. Narrow inter-yarn gaps retain dark micro-occlusion and tiny contact shadows without becoming large holes. Thousands of loose microfibres create a delicate fuzzy halo and soft rim sheen at grazing viewing angles, especially along curves, folds, seams and silhouette edges. The short nap can be brushed or pressed in locally different directions. Under the same illumination this creates a subtle anisotropic response tied to surface normal, light direction and local fibre lay: fibres facing grazing light turn softly pearly and brighter, while neighbouring fibres laid away from it become gently darker. These luminance changes stay local, soft-edged and low-contrast within the single selected upholstery colour; they follow real curves, touch and folds and never form broad panel-scale clouds, stains, repeated blotches or crushed-velvet marbling. Roughness varies within each yarn: matte fibre bodies are punctuated by sparse, narrow satin micro-highlights, never plastic gloss. The fabric follows the product surface without stretching its physical weave scale around rounded edges or tufting. The four physical-sample photographs are the absolute authority for weave, pile, scale and optical response.
avoid_en: micro-weave enlarged into a coarse hero-scale pattern
flat even tone with no local directional nap response
identical blotch rhythm across adjacent channels
cloned or mirrored nap pattern between panels

materials.texture_en: Smooth, slightly grained surface mimicking natural leather with a subtle uniform pore pattern; medium weight, structured and relatively stiff drape holding clean lines; slightly glossy, wipe-clean, modern and sleek.

Luxurious dense pile with a very soft, smooth, uniform surface and a subtle sheen; medium weight, elegant fluid soft and slightly-heavy fall; distinctive light-catching sheen, rich colour depth, subtle highlights and shadows.

materials.noun_en: fine-wale corduroy upholstery fabric with soft cut pile ribs
materials.note: Added 2026-09 for the Lincoln D collection (TRE-92). No physical sample photographed yet — text-only until references are uploaded in the Katalog panel.
materials.texture_en: Fine-wale corduroy: parallel raised ribs (wales) of soft cut pile separated by narrow recessed channels, roughly 1.5–2 mm pitch, running in one consistent direction across each upholstered panel. The ribs are velvety and catch light along their crests, the channels stay slightly darker; the contrast between rib and channel is gentle, not graphic. At normal furniture-photography distance the surface reads as a calm, finely striped velvety textile with a soft directional sheen; the ribs follow the product's curves and change direction only at seams. Matte overall, no plastic gloss, no printed stripes.

materials.noun_en: natural upholstery linen with a visible slightly irregular plain weave
materials.note: Added 2026-09 (TRE-6). Text-only until a physical sample is photographed.
materials.texture_en: Heavy upholstery linen: a plain weave of natural flax yarns with visible, slightly irregular slubs and thickness variation along the threads, giving a gently uneven, organic surface. The weave is fine enough that at furniture distance it reads as a calm matte textile with a subtle crosshatch and occasional thicker slub lines, never as a coarse basket. Completely matte, dry-looking, with soft fold lines where the fabric is tensioned over cushions; no sheen, no pile, no loops.
